description: This file contains functions and logic for handling authentication workflows in the openclaw project, including provider selection, token management, and user prompts.

methods.name: guardCancel
methods.description: Handles user cancellation or symbols, exits process if canceled.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation with styled message, cancels on cancel.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Prompts user for text input with styled message, cancels on cancel.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Prompts user to select from options with styled message, cancels on cancel.

methods.name: resolveDefaultTokenProfileId
methods.description: Generates default token profile ID based on provider.

methods.name: throwIfAnthropicTokenSetupDisabled
methods.description: Throws error if setup-token auth is disabled for 'anthropic' provider.

methods.name: listProvidersWithAuthMethods
methods.description: Filters providers that have authentication methods.

methods.name: listTokenAuthMethods
methods.description: Filters token auth methods from provider.

methods.name: listProvidersWithTokenMethods
methods.description: Filters providers that have token authentication methods.

methods.name: resolveModelsAuthContext
methods.description: Resolves context for models authentication including config, directories, and providers.

methods.name: resolveRequestedProviderOrThrow
methods.description: Resolves provider plugin based on requested name, throws if not found.

methods.name: resolveTokenMethodOrThrow
methods.description: Resolves token auth method for a provider, throws if invalid.

methods.name: pickProviderAuthMethod
methods.description: Prompts user to pick an auth method for a provider.

methods.name: pickProviderTokenMethod
methods.description: Prompts user to pick a token auth method for a provider.

methods.name: persistProviderAuthResult
methods.description: Stores auth result, updates config, and logs info.

methods.name: runProviderAuthMethod
methods.description: Executes the selected provider auth method and persists results.

methods.name: modelsAuthSetupTokenCommand
methods.description: CLI command to set up token auth for a provider.

methods.name: clearStaleProfileLockouts
methods.description: Clears cooldown/lockout states for profiles of a provider.

methods.name: resolveRequestedLoginProviderOrThrow
methods.description: Resolves login provider plugin based on request.

methods.name: credentialMode
methods.description: Determines credential mode ('api_key', 'oauth', 'token') based on credential type.

methods.name: maybeLogOpenAICodexNativeSearchTip
methods.description: Logs tip about native Codex web search if provider is 'openai-codex'.

methods.name: modelsAuthLoginCommand
methods.description: CLI command to perform login with a provider.
